Story: Set up monorepo, branch rules, PR template and CODEOWNERS
Acceptance criteria: Repo live; main is protected; a PR needs 1 review; all four members have merged a PR

Story: CI skeleton: lint, type-check and unit tests on every PR
Acceptance criteria: CI badge is green; a failing test blocks the merge

Story: Board, Definition of Done and working agreement agreed
Acceptance criteria: Board holds every backlog item; each member confirmed the agreement in writing

Story: Freeze intended-use statement and success metrics
Acceptance criteria: One-page statement approved by all; metrics match TRD section 3

Story: Risk register live and sprint rituals running
Acceptance criteria: Top 10 risks have owners and triggers; reviewed every week

Story: Final retro, handover pack and repo archive
Acceptance criteria: Retro notes written; repo tagged v1.0; credentials rotated

Story: Request dataset access; build licence and usage register
Acceptance criteria: Register lists every dataset, licence, access status and allowed use

Story: Download, checksum and version core datasets (downsized copies)
Acceptance criteria: Datasets in versioned storage with checksums; one script reproduces the download

Story: EDA, data cards, patient-level splits and duplicate check (TB, pneumonia)
Acceptance criteria: Split manifests committed; zero patient or near-duplicate overlap across splits; source overlap between TB sets checked

Story: Phone-photo capture protocol and capture kit
Acceptance criteria: Protocol (distance, angle, lighting, phone settings) written and tried once

Story: Photograph test set: 300+ displayed or printed X-rays, 2+ phones
Acceptance criteria: 300+ labelled photos of distinct X-rays; metadata sheet; no personal data in images

Story: Pipeline smoke test: baseline TB classifier end to end
Acceptance criteria: One command trains, evaluates and logs; metrics reproduce within 0.01 AUROC

Story: TB model v1 (small backbone, transfer learning)
Acceptance criteria: Internal test AUROC with 95% CI over 3 seeds; backbone choice documented

Story: Pneumonia model; compare multi-task (masked loss) with separate models
Acceptance criteria: Decision recorded: multi-task if within 0.02 AUROC of separate models

Story: Tune TB and pneumonia models; try teacher-student distillation
Acceptance criteria: Student within 0.02 AUROC of teacher; comparison table

Story: Final model selection, freeze and signed manifests
Acceptance criteria: Each frozen model has a hash, version and model-card link; changes need a new version

Story: DR data prep: APTOS plus EyePACS subsample, splits, preprocessing
Acceptance criteria: Patient-level splits; preprocessing documented; class balance report

Story: DR model v1 (5-grade ordinal plus referable-DR flag)
Acceptance criteria: Referable-DR AUROC with CI; quadratic weighted kappa reported

Story: Spike: live capture guidance (frame, tilt, glare detection)
Acceptance criteria: Demo on reference phone detects tilt and glare at 5 fps; go/no-go note written

Story: Quality checks: blur, glare, exposure, framing, with retake advice
Acceptance criteria: Bad images rejected with a clear reason; runs under 300 ms on the reference phone

Story: Modality and out-of-distribution gate (X-ray, fundus, other)
Acceptance criteria: Rejects at least 95% of non-medical and wrong-type images on a mixed test set

Story: Reference low-end phone and benchmark harness
Acceptance criteria: One script reports latency, memory and load time on the phone

Story: ONNX export and int8 quantization pipeline
Acceptance criteria: Model at most 15 MB; int8 AUROC within 0.015 of fp32

Story: ONNX parity and accuracy-drop checks in CI
Acceptance criteria: CI fails if browser output differs from PyTorch beyond tolerance

Story: Low-end performance tuning (WASM SIMD and threads, warm-up, memory)
Acceptance criteria: p95 inference at most 2.5 s and peak memory at most 350 MB on the reference phone

Story: Calibration (temperature scaling) and three-zone thresholds
Acceptance criteria: ECE at most 0.05 on validation; thresholds meet the sensitivity target; rules documented

Story: Heatmap (class activation map) from model features in the browser
Acceptance criteria: Heatmap renders under 200 ms; sanity check passes (map changes when weights are randomized)

Story: Subgroup and failure analysis (sex, age band, source site, image type)
Acceptance criteria: Metrics table by subgroup; top 20 failures reviewed and categorized

Story: Phone-photo simulation pipeline (glare, tilt, moire, blur, lighting)
Acceptance criteria: Augmentation library with unit tests; sample outputs reviewed by the team

Story: Photo-robust retraining and ablation (clean vs simulated vs real photos)
Acceptance criteria: AUROC drop on real phone photos at most 0.05 after training (target); ablation table

Story: UX plan: interview 3+ health workers; low-fidelity flows
Acceptance criteria: Interview notes; 3 user journeys; first screening reachable in 5 taps or fewer

Story: PWA shell: install, offline cache, routing, design tokens
Acceptance criteria: Installs to home screen; opens offline; passes Lighthouse PWA checks

Story: Capture screen: camera and file upload
Acceptance criteria: Image from camera or gallery reaches the quality gate; EXIF and location stripped

Story: Inference worker: run ONNX in a web worker with model cache
Acceptance criteria: Offline inference on the reference phone; UI stays responsive

Story: Result screen: risk zone, confidence, referral advice, 4-symptom checklist
Acceptance criteria: Zone shown with colour, icon and text; unsure state offers retake or refer; symptoms can raise a zone, never lower it

Story: Local case log: pseudonymous ID, notes, encrypted images
Acceptance criteria: Cases survive restart; images encrypted at rest; 500 cases without slowdown

Story: Capture guidance overlay (live frame, tilt, glare hints, auto-capture)
Acceptance criteria: Fewer retakes per good capture than without the overlay (measured in usability round 2)

Story: Usability round 1 (5+ users) and fixes
Acceptance criteria: Task success at least 90%; top 5 issues fixed or logged

Story: Localization framework and plain-language, icon-first UI
Acceptance criteria: All strings externalized; English reading level grade 8 or lower; key steps use icons

Story: Usability round 2 (5+ users) and polish
Acceptance criteria: SUS at least 75; median time to first result at most 90 s

Story: Supabase project, schema v1, row-level security by facility, audit log
Acceptance criteria: RLS tests: a user from facility A cannot read facility B; audit rows written for sign-in, access, review, deletion

Story: Sync outbox with idempotent upserts and conflict rules
Acceptance criteria: Airplane-mode test: 50 cases queued offline sync with no duplicates or loss

Story: Auth and roles; offline PIN unlock
Acceptance criteria: Three roles enforced; offline unlock valid 14 days; PIN lockout after 5 tries; local cases kept after expiry

Story: Model registry, over-the-air update and rollback
Acceptance criteria: New model version downloads in background; app can roll back to the previous version

Story: Clinician review screen and feedback loop
Acceptance criteria: Reviewer can confirm or correct each result; agreement rate stored

Story: Admin dashboard: volumes, referral rate, reviewer agreement
Acceptance criteria: Dashboard shows counts by facility and week; no patient identifiers

Story: External validation runs (locked external sets, one-shot)
Acceptance criteria: Results table with 95% CIs; external sets untouched until this run

Story: Device benchmark report (reference phone plus one mid-range)
Acceptance criteria: Report covers latency, memory, load time, battery estimate and device compatibility (Android and Chrome versions)

Story: Model cards and results tables
Acceptance criteria: One model card per model: data, metrics, limits, intended use

Story: Regression, offline soak and load tests
Acceptance criteria: 72-hour soak with no crash; regression suite green

Story: Ethics pathway: IRB route, protocol outline, clinic contact
Acceptance criteria: IRB route named; submission checklist; contact person at one clinic

Story: Hazard log v1
Acceptance criteria: Top hazards (missed TB, automation bias, wrong image type) have mitigations

Story: Consent and privacy controls (consent screen, deletion, no image upload by default)
Acceptance criteria: Consent captured before upload; deletion request works end to end

Story: Safety case and limitations section
Acceptance criteria: Hazard log closed or accepted; limitations shown in app and report

Story: Preview deploys, environments and secrets handling
Acceptance criteria: Every PR gets a preview URL; no secrets in the repo

Story: Offline end-to-end tests (Playwright)
Acceptance criteria: Offline capture-to-result flow is tested in CI

Story: Performance budgets and security scan in CI
Acceptance criteria: CI fails on app shell over 300 KB gzip or high-severity findings

Story: Release pipeline, backups and monitoring
Acceptance criteria: One-command release and rollback; daily DB backup restored once; opt-in error logs and billing alert set

Story: Report: ML methods and results
Acceptance criteria: Methods, results, limits and reproducibility sections complete

Story: Deployment and operations runbook
Acceptance criteria: A teammate follows the runbook and deploys from scratch

Story: Report: system design, HCI and safety
Acceptance criteria: Architecture, usability results and safety case sections complete

Story: Demo video and live demo script
Acceptance criteria: 3-minute video; offline live demo rehearsed twice; backup recording ready

Story: User guide, README and developer docs
Acceptance criteria: Health-worker quick guide (1 page) and developer README tested by a newcomer

Story: DICOM file support in the browser (parse, window/level, strip tags)
Acceptance criteria: Pull in first: digital X-ray files are the easy case clinics may already have

Story: Local retrospective validation at a partner clinic
Acceptance criteria: Only if ethics approval and a data-sharing agreement are in place by week 5

Story: Lung-field segmentation (U-Net) to crop the X-ray before classification
Acceptance criteria: If external TB results show poor transfer; reuses the U-Net replication

Story: Printable offline referral slip (PDF)
Acceptance criteria: If usability tests ask for it

Story: Twi, Ga and Ewe UI strings with native-speaker review
Acceptance criteria: After the localization framework (E8-09) is done

Story: Agentic evaluation reporter: runs the benchmark suite on each new model and drafts the model card for human review
Acceptance criteria: If model versions are changing often

Story: Native Android build (TFLite) compared with the PWA
Acceptance criteria: If PWA latency misses the budget on the reference phone

Story: Agentic referral-letter drafting (online only, clinician-edited, never diagnostic)
Acceptance criteria: Only after safety case sign-off

Story: Lung ultrasound (POCUS) pneumonia classifier prototype
Acceptance criteria: Only if ahead of plan; adds a third image type

Story: Federated learning simulation across 3 simulated sites
Acceptance criteria: Research extra; only if ahead of plan
